_comment: Vehicles on the simulated vessel. Each has 2-4 views of the SAME physical car (one folder per vehicle). Every view is openly licensed (CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA - never NC or ND) and publicly available at `source`. Images were resized to 1024 px on the long edge; nothing else was altered. CC BY and CC BY-SA require attribution: the demo shows it and CREDITS.md lists it. observed_lane is refreshed by scripts/record_vessel_replay.py and is used only to balance a live run.
